text_en: An adult pottery student stands beside the instructor in the studio. The instructor unlocks the heavy kiln door and pulls it open. Warm air drifts out. The student's finished bowl sits on the middle shelf, still radiating heat. The student watches closely as the instructor reaches in to lift the bowl out. The instructor lifts the bowl and turns it slowly. The glaze has settled into a deep, even blue with a subtle crackle pattern that the student had hoped for. The rim is perfectly round, and the foot is clean. The student immediately thinks about placing it on the kitchen shelf at home, where it will be used every morning for tea.
text_zh: 一位成人陶艺学生站在工作室里，紧挨着指导老师。指导老师打开窑炉沉重的门并拉开。温热的气流飘出。学生完成的碗放在中层架子上，仍散发着热量。学生紧盯着指导老师伸手进去把碗取出。指导老师把碗举起，慢慢转动。釉色沉淀成深邃均匀的蓝色，带有学生一直期望的细微开片纹。碗沿完美浑圆，圈足干净利落。学生立刻想到把它放在家中厨房的架子上，每天早上用它喝茶。

text_en: An adult pottery student stands beside the instructor in the studio. The instructor unlocks the heavy kiln door and pulls it open. Warm air drifts out. The student's finished bowl sits on the middle shelf, still radiating heat. The student watches closely as the instructor reaches in to lift the bowl out. The instructor lifts the bowl, but the glaze has turned a dull gray instead of the bright turquoise the student had mixed. The instructor checks the kiln log and finds the temperature had been set twenty degrees lower than planned. The student stares at the bowl, then at the log, then back at the bowl, trying to understand how the color changed so completely.
text_zh: 一位成人陶艺学生站在工作室里，紧挨着指导老师。指导老师打开窑炉沉重的门并拉开。温热的气流飘出。学生完成的碗放在中层架子上，仍散发着热量。学生紧盯着指导老师伸手进去把碗取出。指导老师把碗举起，但釉色变成了暗灰色，而不是学生调配的亮蓝绿色。指导老师查看窑炉记录，发现温度比计划低了二十度。学生盯着碗，又看看记录，再看看碗，试图弄明白颜色怎么会变得如此彻底。

text_en: An adult pottery student stands beside the instructor in the studio. The instructor unlocks the heavy kiln door and pulls it open. Warm air drifts out. The student's finished bowl sits on the middle shelf, still radiating heat. The student watches closely as the instructor reaches in to lift the bowl out. As the instructor lifts the bowl, a loud crack sounds from the shelf above. A heavy kiln shelf shifts and begins to slide. The student steps back quickly, seeing the shelf edge tilt toward the bowl and the instructor's hand. The student's mind races, calculating whether the falling shelf will crush the bowl or the instructor's arm before they can move away.
text_zh: 一位成人陶艺学生站在工作室里，紧挨着指导老师。指导老师打开窑炉沉重的门并拉开。温热的气流飘出。学生完成的碗放在中层架子上，仍散发着热量。学生紧盯着指导老师伸手进去把碗取出。指导老师举起碗时，上层架子传来一声响亮的裂响。一块沉重的窑板移位并开始滑落。学生迅速后退，看到窑板边缘朝碗和指导老师的手倾斜。学生脑中飞速计算，掉落的窑板会不会在两人躲开之前砸碎碗或压到指导老师的手臂。

text_en: An adult pottery student stands beside the instructor in the studio. The instructor unlocks the heavy kiln door and pulls it open. Warm air drifts out. The student's finished bowl sits on the middle shelf, still radiating heat. The student watches closely as the instructor reaches in to lift the bowl out. The instructor lifts the bowl, but a dark, sticky residue coats the inside surface. A sour, moldy smell rises from the bowl, and the student sees a thin film of what looks like old food scraps stuck to the glaze. The student realizes the bowl had been used to hold leftover clay slurry that had fermented. The student sets the bowl down on the workbench, not wanting to touch it again.
text_zh: 一位成人陶艺学生站在工作室里，紧挨着指导老师。指导老师打开窑炉沉重的门并拉开。温热的气流飘出。学生完成的碗放在中层架子上，仍散发着热量。学生紧盯着指导老师伸手进去把碗取出。指导老师把碗举起，但内壁覆盖着一层深色黏稠残留物。一股酸腐发霉的气味从碗里升起，学生看到一层薄薄的、像陈旧食物残渣的东西粘在釉面上。学生意识到这个碗曾被用来盛放发酵过的黏土泥浆。学生把碗放在工作台上，不想再碰它。

text_en: An adult pottery student stands beside the instructor in the studio. The instructor unlocks the heavy kiln door and pulls it open. Warm air drifts out. The student's finished bowl sits on the middle shelf, still radiating heat. The student watches closely as the instructor reaches in to lift the bowl out. The instructor lifts the bowl, and the student sees a large, deep scratch running across the inside surface. The instructor shrugs and says, 'That must have happened when you stacked it carelessly.' The student knows the bowl had been placed alone on the shelf, and the scratch looks like it came from a metal tool. The instructor had been the only person with access to the kiln since yesterday.
text_zh: 一位成人陶艺学生站在工作室里，紧挨着指导老师。指导老师打开窑炉沉重的门并拉开。温热的气流飘出。学生完成的碗放在中层架子上，仍散发着热量。学生紧盯着指导老师伸手进去把碗取出。指导老师把碗举起，学生看到内壁有一道又深又长的划痕。指导老师耸耸肩说：“这肯定是你堆放时不小心弄的。”学生知道碗是单独放在架子上的，而划痕看起来像是金属工具造成的。从昨天起，只有指导老师能接触窑炉。

text_en: An adult pottery student stands beside the instructor in the studio. The instructor unlocks the heavy kiln door and pulls it open. Warm air drifts out. The student's finished bowl sits on the middle shelf, still radiating heat. The student watches closely as the instructor reaches in to lift the bowl out. The instructor lifts the bowl, but the bottom has cracked completely through, splitting the bowl into two uneven halves. The instructor confirms that the clay had not been dried evenly before firing. The student holds the two pieces, feeling the rough edges where they broke. The bowl was meant to be a gift for a friend who is moving away next week. Now there is no time to make another one.
text_zh: 一位成人陶艺学生站在工作室里，紧挨着指导老师。指导老师打开窑炉沉重的门并拉开。温热的气流飘出。学生完成的碗放在中层架子上，仍散发着热量。学生紧盯着指导老师伸手进去把碗取出。指导老师把碗举起，但碗底完全裂穿，碗裂成两半，形状不均。指导老师确认是烧制前黏土没有均匀晾干。学生捧着两半碎片，摸着断裂处的粗糙边缘。这个碗本是要送给下周搬走的朋友的礼物。现在没有时间再做一个了。

text_en: An adult pottery student stands beside the instructor in the studio. The instructor unlocks the heavy kiln door and pulls it open. Warm air drifts out. The student's finished bowl sits on the middle shelf, still radiating heat. The student watches closely as the instructor reaches in to lift the bowl out. The instructor lifts the bowl and places it on the workbench. The glaze is a medium brown, similar to the sample tile the student had tested last week. The bowl is slightly heavier than expected, but the shape is intact. The student picks it up, checks the bottom for any cracks, finds none, and sets it aside to cool with the other finished pieces.
text_zh: 一位成人陶艺学生站在工作室里，紧挨着指导老师。指导老师打开窑炉沉重的门并拉开。温热的气流飘出。学生完成的碗放在中层架子上，仍散发着热量。学生紧盯着指导老师伸手进去把碗取出。指导老师把碗举起，放在工作台上。釉色是中棕色，和上周学生测试的样品砖差不多。碗比预想的稍重一些，但形状完好。学生拿起碗，检查底部没有裂纹，然后把它放到一边，和其他完成的作品一起冷却。

text_en: After the routine examination of her dog, Mia sits in the veterinary clinic’s consultation room. The veterinarian enters with a clipboard and a printed report. Mia waits to hear the results and what they mean for her dog’s daily care. The veterinarian says the blood work shows excellent organ function, and the mild joint stiffness has improved with the new diet. Mia’s dog will need no medication and can resume longer walks. She immediately thinks about planning a weekend hike together, feeling the plan is set.
text_zh: 她的狗做完常规检查后，米娅坐在兽医诊所的诊室里。兽医拿着记录板和打印报告走进来。米娅等着听结果，以及这对她狗的日常护理意味着什么。兽医说血液检查显示器官功能极佳，新的饮食也让轻微的关节僵硬有所改善。米娅的狗不需要用药，可以恢复更长的散步。她立刻想到计划周末一起去远足，觉得这个安排已经定下来了。

text_en: After the routine examination of her dog, Mia sits in the veterinary clinic’s consultation room. The veterinarian enters with a clipboard and a printed report. Mia waits to hear the results and what they mean for her dog’s daily care. The veterinarian says the report shows a microchip that Mia never knew about, registered to a rescue organization from another city. The dog’s records indicate a previous owner who had reported it lost two years ago. Mia pauses, then asks for the contact details to verify the information.
text_zh: 她的狗做完常规检查后，米娅坐在兽医诊所的诊室里。兽医拿着记录板和打印报告走进来。米娅等着听结果，以及这对她狗的日常护理意味着什么。兽医说报告显示一个米娅从不知道的微芯片，注册信息来自另一个城市的救助组织。狗的记录显示两年前曾有前主人报失。米娅停顿了一下，然后要求提供联系方式以核实这个信息。

text_en: After the routine examination of her dog, Mia sits in the veterinary clinic’s consultation room. The veterinarian enters with a clipboard and a printed report. Mia waits to hear the results and what they mean for her dog’s daily care. The veterinarian points to a shadow on the X-ray and says it may be a tumor, but further tests are needed. Mia’s dog has been eating normally, so she had no warning. She immediately asks how soon the biopsy can be scheduled, her mind already on the possible outcomes.
text_zh: 她的狗做完常规检查后，米娅坐在兽医诊所的诊室里。兽医拿着记录板和打印报告走进来。米娅等着听结果，以及这对她狗的日常护理意味着什么。兽医指着X光片上的阴影，说可能是肿瘤，但需要进一步检查。米娅的狗一直正常进食，所以她没有任何预兆。她立刻询问活检能多快安排，心里已经在想各种可能的结果。

text_en: After the routine examination of her dog, Mia sits in the veterinary clinic’s consultation room. The veterinarian enters with a clipboard and a printed report. Mia waits to hear the results and what they mean for her dog’s daily care. The veterinarian opens the dog’s ear and shows a thick, dark discharge with a sour smell. A swab reveals a yeast infection, and the ear canal is inflamed. Mia steps back slightly, then asks for the cleaning solution and instructions to treat it at home.
text_zh: 她的狗做完常规检查后，米娅坐在兽医诊所的诊室里。兽医拿着记录板和打印报告走进来。米娅等着听结果，以及这对她狗的日常护理意味着什么。兽医打开狗的耳朵，露出浓稠的深色分泌物，带着酸味。棉签采样显示酵母菌感染，耳道发炎。米娅稍微后退了一步，然后要求提供清洁液和在家治疗的说明。

text_en: After the routine examination of her dog, Mia sits in the veterinary clinic’s consultation room. The veterinarian enters with a clipboard and a printed report. Mia waits to hear the results and what they mean for her dog’s daily care. The veterinarian says the previous clinic failed to record a vaccine booster, so the dog must be revaccinated today, costing extra time and money. Mia recalls she had paid for that booster last year. She asks to see the old invoice, intending to challenge the mistake.
text_zh: 她的狗做完常规检查后，米娅坐在兽医诊所的诊室里。兽医拿着记录板和打印报告走进来。米娅等着听结果，以及这对她狗的日常护理意味着什么。兽医说之前的诊所没有记录加强疫苗，所以今天必须重新接种，额外花费时间和金钱。米娅记得去年她已经付过加强疫苗的费用。她要求查看旧发票，打算质疑这个错误。

text_en: After the routine examination of her dog, Mia sits in the veterinary clinic’s consultation room. The veterinarian enters with a clipboard and a printed report. Mia waits to hear the results and what they mean for her dog’s daily care. The veterinarian explains that the dog’s kidney function has declined significantly and cannot be reversed. The recommended plan is palliative care, with a focus on comfort. Mia looks at her dog, then asks about the expected timeline and what changes to make at home.
text_zh: 她的狗做完常规检查后，米娅坐在兽医诊所的诊室里。兽医拿着记录板和打印报告走进来。米娅等着听结果，以及这对她狗的日常护理意味着什么。兽医解释说狗的肾功能已明显下降，且无法逆转。建议的方案是姑息护理，以舒适为主。米娅看着她的狗，然后询问预期的时间线以及在家需要做哪些调整。

text_en: After the routine examination of her dog, Mia sits in the veterinary clinic’s consultation room. The veterinarian enters with a clipboard and a printed report. Mia waits to hear the results and what they mean for her dog’s daily care. The veterinarian says the examination results are within normal ranges, and the dog’s weight is stable. The only note is to continue the current food and schedule a routine check in six months. Mia nods, takes the printed summary, and prepares to leave with her dog.
text_zh: 她的狗做完常规检查后，米娅坐在兽医诊所的诊室里。兽医拿着记录板和打印报告走进来。米娅等着听结果，以及这对她狗的日常护理意味着什么。兽医说检查结果都在正常范围内，狗的体重稳定。唯一需要注意的是继续目前的饮食，并在六个月后安排常规检查。米娅点点头，拿起打印的摘要，准备带着狗离开。

text_en: A commuter arrives at a repair shop on a weekday afternoon to inspect a bicycle left there for servicing. The bike had been brought in two days earlier for a brake adjustment and a new chain. The shop is quiet, with a few other bikes hanging from the ceiling. The commuter approaches the counter. The mechanic hands over the bike with a freshly installed chain and perfectly aligned brakes. The commuter takes a quick test ride around the block; the pedaling is smooth and the stopping is instant. The total cost matches the original estimate. The commuter pays, then rides off toward home, already planning a longer weekend trip on this reliable bike.
text_zh: 一名通勤者在工作日下午来到一家修车店，检查之前送来维修的自行车。这辆车两天前送来，需要调整刹车并更换链条。店里很安静，天花板上挂着几辆其他自行车。通勤者走向柜台。修车师傅递过自行车，链条是新的，刹车也调得恰到好处。通勤者骑上车在街区快速试了一圈，踩踏顺畅，刹车灵敏。总费用与最初报价一致。通勤者付了钱，骑车往家走，心里已经在计划周末骑这辆可靠的车去更远的地方。

text_en: A commuter arrives at a repair shop on a weekday afternoon to inspect a bicycle left there for servicing. The bike had been brought in two days earlier for a brake adjustment and a new chain. The shop is quiet, with a few other bikes hanging from the ceiling. The commuter approaches the counter. The mechanic brings out a different bicycle—a newer model with a similar frame but upgraded components. The commuter checks the serial number and realizes the shop had mistakenly swapped the bike with another customer's. The commuter points out the error, and the mechanic apologizes, retrieving the original from the back. The commuter waits while the correct bike is brought out.
text_zh: 一名通勤者在工作日下午来到一家修车店，检查之前送来维修的自行车。这辆车两天前送来，需要调整刹车并更换链条。店里很安静，天花板上挂着几辆其他自行车。通勤者走向柜台。修车师傅推出一辆不同的自行车——车架相似但配置更高的新款。通勤者核对车架号，发现店里误把另一名顾客的车拿了出来。通勤者指出错误，师傅道歉后从后面取回了原车。通勤者等着正确的车被推出来。

text_en: A commuter arrives at a repair shop on a weekday afternoon to inspect a bicycle left there for servicing. The bike had been brought in two days earlier for a brake adjustment and a new chain. The shop is quiet, with a few other bikes hanging from the ceiling. The commuter approaches the counter. As the mechanic rolls the bike forward, the front wheel wobbles and then locks up, causing the bike to jerk violently. The mechanic inspects the brake cable and finds it frayed near the lever. The commuter watches the mechanic pull at the loose strand, realizing that if the cable had snapped during a fast descent, the front brake would have failed completely. The commuter steps back from the counter.
text_zh: 一名通勤者在工作日下午来到一家修车店，检查之前送来维修的自行车。这辆车两天前送来，需要调整刹车并更换链条。店里很安静，天花板上挂着几辆其他自行车。通勤者走向柜台。修车师傅把自行车往前推时，前轮晃动了一下然后卡住，车子猛地一顿。师傅检查刹车线，发现靠近手柄处已经磨损起毛。通勤者看着师傅拉扯那根松散的钢丝，意识到如果在下坡高速时这根线断掉，前刹车就会完全失灵。通勤者往后退了一步，离开柜台。

text_en: A commuter arrives at a repair shop on a weekday afternoon to inspect a bicycle left there for servicing. The bike had been brought in two days earlier for a brake adjustment and a new chain. The shop is quiet, with a few other bikes hanging from the ceiling. The commuter approaches the counter. The mechanic lifts the bike onto the stand, and a dark, sticky liquid drips from the chain area onto the floor. The commuter looks closer and sees a clump of greasy hair and food scraps wedged between the chainring and the frame. The mechanic wipes it with a rag, but the smell of rancid oil and old food lingers. The commuter moves to the other side of the counter, keeping distance from the bike.
text_zh: 一名通勤者在工作日下午来到一家修车店，检查之前送来维修的自行车。这辆车两天前送来，需要调整刹车并更换链条。店里很安静，天花板上挂着几辆其他自行车。通勤者走向柜台。修车师傅把自行车抬上维修架，链条处滴下深色黏稠的液体，落在地板上。通勤者凑近一看，发现链轮和车架之间卡着一团油腻的头发和食物残渣。师傅用抹布擦掉，但酸败的油味和旧食物的气味仍留在空气中。通勤者走到柜台另一侧，与自行车保持距离。

text_en: A commuter arrives at a repair shop on a weekday afternoon to inspect a bicycle left there for servicing. The bike had been brought in two days earlier for a brake adjustment and a new chain. The shop is quiet, with a few other bikes hanging from the ceiling. The commuter approaches the counter. The mechanic shrugs and says the brake adjustment was done, but the commuter notices the brake pads are still misaligned, rubbing against the rim. The commuter asks why the work wasn't completed as requested. The mechanic replies that the shop was busy and the commuter should have come earlier. The commuter points at the original work order, but the mechanic turns away to help another customer.
text_zh: 一名通勤者在工作日下午来到一家修车店，检查之前送来维修的自行车。这辆车两天前送来，需要调整刹车并更换链条。店里很安静，天花板上挂着几辆其他自行车。通勤者走向柜台。修车师傅耸耸肩说刹车已经调好了，但通勤者看到刹车皮仍然偏斜，蹭着轮圈。通勤者问为什么没有按要求完成工作。师傅回答说店里太忙，通勤者应该早点来。通勤者指着原始工单，但师傅转身去招呼另一位顾客了。

text_en: A commuter arrives at a repair shop on a weekday afternoon to inspect a bicycle left there for servicing. The bike had been brought in two days earlier for a brake adjustment and a new chain. The shop is quiet, with a few other bikes hanging from the ceiling. The commuter approaches the counter. The mechanic brings out the bike, but the frame has a long crack near the bottom bracket. The mechanic explains that the crack was hidden under the paint and was only discovered after removing the chain. The repair would cost more than the bike's value, and the mechanic recommends replacing it. The commuter runs a hand over the cracked metal, then stands silently, looking at the bike that had been ridden for years.
text_zh: 一名通勤者在工作日下午来到一家修车店，检查之前送来维修的自行车。这辆车两天前送来，需要调整刹车并更换链条。店里很安静，天花板上挂着几辆其他自行车。通勤者走向柜台。修车师傅推出自行车，但车架靠近中轴处有一条长长的裂纹。师傅解释说裂纹原本被漆面遮住，拆下链条后才被发现。维修费用超过这辆车的价值，师傅建议直接换新车。通勤者用手摸过那道裂纹，然后默默站着，看着这辆骑了好几年的车。

text_en: A commuter arrives at a repair shop on a weekday afternoon to inspect a bicycle left there for servicing. The bike had been brought in two days earlier for a brake adjustment and a new chain. The shop is quiet, with a few other bikes hanging from the ceiling. The commuter approaches the counter. The mechanic brings the bike out and confirms the brake adjustment and new chain are done. The commuter checks the brakes by squeezing the levers and sees the chain is properly tensioned. The total cost is the same as the estimate. The commuter pays the amount, takes the receipt, and wheels the bike out of the shop to ride home.
text_zh: 一名通勤者在工作日下午来到一家修车店，检查之前送来维修的自行车。这辆车两天前送来，需要调整刹车并更换链条。店里很安静，天花板上挂着几辆其他自行车。通勤者走向柜台。修车师傅推出自行车，确认刹车调整和新链条都已完成。通勤者捏了捏刹车手柄检查，又看了看链条松紧度正常。总费用与报价一致。通勤者付了钱，拿了收据，推着车走出店门，骑车回家。

text_en: At 7 a.m., Mei, a volunteer at the community kitchen, unlocks the back door to receive the weekly supply delivery. As Mei checks the last box, she finds an extra crate of fresh vegetables and a note from the local farm saying they donated it to support the kitchen. The kitchen will have more than enough ingredients for today's meals, and she can even plan a special dish for the regular guests. She immediately calls the head cook to share the good news, already thinking about how to use the surplus.
text_zh: 早上7点，社区厨房的志愿者小梅打开后门，接收每周的物资配送。卡车准时到达，司机把库存清单递给她。她开始对照订单检查箱子，知道当天的餐食供应就靠这些物资。小梅检查最后一个箱子时，发现多了一箱新鲜蔬菜，还有当地农场的便条，说这是捐赠给厨房的。今天的食材不仅够用，还能为常客加一道特色菜。她立刻打电话给主厨分享这个好消息，心里已经在盘算怎么利用这些多余的食材。

text_en: At midday, a hiker reaches a ranger checkpoint on a popular trail. The ranger, who has been on duty since morning, hands over a printed route update. The hiker reads it carefully, noting the details about the next section of the path. The update says the trail ahead has been recently cleared and marked with fresh signs. A stream crossing now has a sturdy bridge, and the next campsite offers a scenic view. The hiker folds the paper, puts it in a pocket, and steps forward with a light stride, looking forward to the rest of the walk.
text_zh: 中午时分，一名徒步者到达了一条热门小径上的护林员检查站。护林员从早上起就在值班，递过来一份打印的路线更新。徒步者仔细阅读，注意到关于下一段路径的细节。更新显示前方小径最近已被清理，并标有新的指示牌。一处溪流现在有了坚固的桥梁，下一个营地提供风景优美的视野。徒步者折好纸张，放进口袋，轻快地迈步向前，期待接下来的路程。

text_en: At midday, a hiker reaches a ranger checkpoint on a popular trail. The ranger, who has been on duty since morning, hands over a printed route update. The hiker reads it carefully, noting the details about the next section of the path. The update states that the trail ahead is closed due to a landslide, but it suggests an alternate route that goes through a cave. The hiker had read online that the cave was sealed years ago. Pausing, the hiker rereads the line, then checks the map again to confirm the route change.
text_zh: 中午时分，一名徒步者到达了一条热门小径上的护林员检查站。护林员从早上起就在值班，递过来一份打印的路线更新。徒步者仔细阅读，注意到关于下一段路径的细节。更新显示前方小径因山体滑坡而关闭，但建议了一条穿过洞穴的替代路线。徒步者曾在网上读到该洞穴多年前已被封堵。徒步者停下来，重读那一行，又查看地图以确认路线变更。

text_en: At midday, a hiker reaches a ranger checkpoint on a popular trail. The ranger, who has been on duty since morning, hands over a printed route update. The hiker reads it carefully, noting the details about the next section of the path. The update warns of recent bear activity ahead, with fresh tracks near the trail. It advises turning back before dusk. The hiker glances at the dense forest ahead, then at the sky, and calculates how long it would take to return to the trailhead. The paper feels heavy in hand.
text_zh: 中午时分，一名徒步者到达了一条热门小径上的护林员检查站。护林员从早上起就在值班，递过来一份打印的路线更新。徒步者仔细阅读，注意到关于下一段路径的细节。更新警告前方近期有熊出没，小径附近有新鲜足迹。建议黄昏前折返。徒步者瞥了一眼前方茂密的森林，又看看天空，计算返回起点需要多长时间。手中的纸张感觉沉甸甸的。

text_en: At midday, a hiker reaches a ranger checkpoint on a popular trail. The ranger, who has been on duty since morning, hands over a printed route update. The thought of walking through that area makes the hiker consider an alternate route.

text_en: A stage manager inspects a newly delivered prop shortly before a community-theater rehearsal. The prop is a wooden chest that will be used in the opening scene. The manager checks the latch, hinges, and interior, noting the delivery was on time and the craftsmanship looks solid. The manager opens the chest and finds a handwritten note from the director tucked inside, thanking the crew for their hard work. The note also mentions that the director has secured an extra rehearsal space for the week. The manager reads it twice, then carefully places the note on the prop table, feeling a warm sense of recognition and looking forward to sharing the good news with the team.
text_zh: 一位舞台监督在社区剧院排练前不久检查一个新送达的道具。道具是一个将在开场戏中使用的木箱。监督检查了锁扣、铰链和内部，注意到送货准时，做工看起来扎实。监督打开箱子，发现里面夹着一张导演手写的便条，感谢剧组的辛勤工作。便条还提到导演为本周争取到了额外的排练场地。监督读了两遍，然后小心地把便条放在道具桌上，感到一种被认可的温暖，并期待与团队分享这个好消息。

text_en: A stage manager inspects a newly delivered prop shortly before a community-theater rehearsal. The prop is a wooden chest that will be used in the opening scene. The manager checks the latch, hinges, and interior, noting the delivery was on time and the craftsmanship looks solid. The manager expects the chest to be empty, but when the lid is lifted, a small spring-loaded puppet pops up and waves. The manager had no prior warning about any mechanism inside. After a brief pause, the manager closes the lid and reopens it, confirming the puppet appears only on the first opening. The manager then checks the delivery invoice, which lists no such feature, and makes a note to ask the prop supplier about it.
text_zh: 一位舞台监督在社区剧院排练前不久检查一个新送达的道具。道具是一个将在开场戏中使用的木箱。监督检查了锁扣、铰链和内部，注意到送货准时，做工看起来扎实。监督原以为箱子是空的，但打开盖子时，一个装有弹簧的小木偶突然弹出并挥手。监督事先没有收到任何关于内部机关的提示。短暂停顿后，监督关上盖子再打开，确认木偶只在第一次打开时出现。随后监督检查了送货单，上面没有列出这一功能，并记下要向道具供应商询问此事。

text_en: A stage manager inspects a newly delivered prop shortly before a community-theater rehearsal. The prop is a wooden chest that will be used in the opening scene. The manager checks the latch, hinges, and interior, noting the delivery was on time and the craftsmanship looks solid. As the manager runs a hand along the interior, a sharp edge slices the palm. The cut is deep, and blood begins to drip onto the stage floor. The manager realizes the chest's inner lining has a broken metal splinter, and the wound needs immediate attention. The manager quickly wraps a cloth around the hand and heads to the first-aid kit, worried about infection and the rehearsal delay.
text_zh: 一位舞台监督在社区剧院排练前不久检查一个新送达的道具。道具是一个将在开场戏中使用的木箱。监督检查了锁扣、铰链和内部，注意到送货准时，做工看起来扎实。当监督用手沿内部滑动时，一个锋利的边缘划破了手掌。伤口很深，血开始滴落在舞台地板上。监督意识到箱子内衬有一块断裂的金属碎片，伤口需要立即处理。监督迅速用布包住手，走向急救箱，担心感染和排练延误。

text_en: A stage manager inspects a newly delivered prop shortly before a community-theater rehearsal. The prop is a wooden chest that will be used in the opening scene. The manager steps back, holding the lid at arm's length, and decides the chest cannot be used until it is thoroughly cleaned and sanitized. The manager calls the prop master to arrange for disposal of the contaminated lining.

text_en: A stage manager inspects a newly delivered prop shortly before a community-theater rehearsal. The prop is a wooden chest that will be used in the opening scene. The manager checks the latch, hinges, and interior, noting the delivery was on time and the craftsmanship looks solid. The manager tries to fix the latch but finds it stripped, making the chest unusable for the rehearsal. The manager calls the delivery company, demanding a replacement and an explanation for the repeated negligence.
text_zh: 一位舞台监督在社区剧院排练前不久检查一个新送达的道具。道具是一个将在开场戏中使用的木箱。监督检查了锁扣、铰链和内部，注意到送货准时，做工看起来扎实。监督注意到箱子的锁扣错位，而送货人员曾标记为“已检查并批准”。监督记得同一批送货人员有粗心操作的前科。监督试图修理锁扣，但发现螺纹已滑丝，箱子无法用于排练。监督打电话给送货公司，要求更换并解释这种反复出现的疏忽。

The manager checks the latch, hinges, and interior, noting the delivery was on time and the craftsmanship looks solid. The manager opens the chest and finds that the interior is water-damaged, with the wood warped and the velvet lining stained. The chest was a custom piece that the director had specially ordered for this production, and it is now beyond repair. The manager realizes the prop cannot be used and there is no time to order a replacement. The manager closes the lid slowly, thinking of the director's excitement when the chest was first mentioned.
text_zh: 一位舞台监督在社区剧院排练前不久检查一个新送达的道具。道具是一个将在开场戏中使用的木箱。监督检查了锁扣、铰链和内部，注意到送货准时，做工看起来扎实。监督打开箱子，发现内部受潮，木头变形，天鹅绒衬里也有污渍。这个箱子是导演为这次演出特别定制的，现在已无法修复。监督意识到这个道具无法使用，而且没有时间订购替代品。监督慢慢关上盖子，想到导演最初提到这个箱子时的兴奋。

text_en: A stage manager inspects a newly delivered prop shortly before a community-theater rehearsal. The prop is a wooden chest that will be used in the opening scene. The manager checks the latch, hinges, and interior, noting the delivery was on time and the craftsmanship looks solid. The manager opens the chest and checks the interior. The wood is smooth, the hinges are oiled, and the latch closes securely. The manager closes the lid and lifts the chest to test its weight, finding it manageable. The manager then places the chest on the stage where it will be used, and proceeds to review the rehearsal schedule for the evening.
text_zh: 一位舞台监督在社区剧院排练前不久检查一个新送达的道具。道具是一个将在开场戏中使用的木箱。监督检查了锁扣、铰链和内部，注意到送货准时，做工看起来扎实。监督打开箱子并检查内部。木头光滑，铰链已上油，锁扣关闭牢固。监督关上盖子并提起箱子测试重量，发现可以轻松搬动。随后监督将箱子放在舞台上将要使用的位置，并继续查看当晚的排练日程。

text_en: Lin, a small-batch jam maker, arrives at the city farmers market at 7 a.m. with a cooler of jars. The market manager hands over the stall assignment and a clipboard with inspection notes. Lin reads the notes carefully before setting up. The inspection notes say the stall is in a prime corner spot, and the manager has added a free second table. Lin's best-selling peach jam sold out here last month, and the notes mention a regular customer who asked to reserve a case. Lin begins arranging jars, already planning to call that customer after setup.
text_zh: 林，一位小批量果酱制作者，早上7点到达城市农夫市集，带着一箱罐子。市场经理递过摊位分配单和一块夹着检查记录的写字板。林在布置前仔细阅读记录。检查记录显示摊位位于黄金角落位置，经理还加了一张免费的第二张桌子。林上个月在这里售罄了最畅销的桃子果酱，记录提到一位老顾客要求预留一箱。林开始摆放罐子，已经计划布置完后给那位顾客打电话。

text_en: Lin, a small-batch jam maker, arrives at the city farmers market at 7 a.m. with a cooler of jars. The market manager hands over the stall assignment and a clipboard with inspection notes. Lin reads the notes carefully before setting up. The notes say the stall number is 12, but the manager points to a spot marked 12—which is currently occupied by a large tent selling honey. Lin checks the map again: the assigned stall is actually on the far side of the lot, not the usual row. Lin walks over to find the honey seller already set up there, with no sign of moving.
text_zh: 林，一位小批量果酱制作者，早上7点到达城市农夫市集，带着一箱罐子。市场经理递过摊位分配单和一块夹着检查记录的写字板。林在布置前仔细阅读记录。记录上写着摊位号是12，但经理指向一个标着12的位置——那里已被一个卖蜂蜜的大帐篷占据。林再次查看地图：分配的摊位实际上在场地远端，不是通常的那一排。林走过去，发现蜂蜜卖家已经在那里摆好，毫无搬走的意思。

text_en: Lin, a small-batch jam maker, arrives at the city farmers market at 7 a.m. with a cooler of jars. The market manager hands over the stall assignment and a clipboard with inspection notes. Lin reads the notes carefully before setting up. The inspection notes include a health-code violation from last week: a jar seal failed, and the batch was recalled. The manager says a follow-up inspection is scheduled for this morning, and if any current jar shows the same issue, the stall will be closed immediately. Lin opens the cooler and pulls out a jar to check the lid, hands moving slowly.
text_zh: 林，一位小批量果酱制作者，早上7点到达城市农夫市集，带着一箱罐子。市场经理递过摊位分配单和一块夹着检查记录的写字板。林在布置前仔细阅读记录。检查记录包含上周的一项卫生违规：一个罐子封口失败，该批次被召回。经理说今天上午安排了复查，如果当前任何一罐出现同样问题，摊位将立即关闭。林打开冷藏箱，拿出一罐检查盖子，手缓慢移动。

text_en: Lin, a small-batch jam maker, arrives at the city farmers market at 7 a.m. with a cooler of jars. The market manager hands over the stall assignment and a clipboard with inspection notes. Lin reads the notes carefully before setting up. The notes say the previous stall holder left a bin of rotten fruit behind the counter. Lin peeks under the table and sees a sticky puddle with fruit flies swarming over moldy peach skins. The smell of fermenting pulp rises. Lin steps back, pulls out a roll of paper towels, and looks for a trash bag to remove the mess before touching any jars.
text_zh: 林，一位小批量果酱制作者，早上7点到达城市农夫市集，带着一箱罐子。市场经理递过摊位分配单和一块夹着检查记录的写字板。林在布置前仔细阅读记录。记录显示上一位摊主在柜台后留下了一箱腐烂水果。林瞥见桌下有一滩黏糊糊的液体，果蝇在发霉的桃皮上乱飞。发酵果肉的气味升起。林后退一步，抽出一卷纸巾，寻找垃圾袋，准备在碰任何罐子前清理这堆脏物。

text_en: Lin, a small-batch jam maker, arrives at the city farmers market at 7 a.m. with a cooler of jars. The market manager hands over the stall assignment and a clipboard with inspection notes. Lin reads the notes carefully before setting up. The notes say the stall assignment was changed at the last minute, and the manager admits a friend of the honey seller received Lin's original corner spot. The new location is a cramped, shaded area near the restrooms, with no power outlet. Lin folds the clipboard note, then sets it down and asks the manager to reverse the change, but the manager shrugs and walks away.
text_zh: 林，一位小批量果酱制作者，早上7点到达城市农夫市集，带着一箱罐子。市场经理递过摊位分配单和一块夹着检查记录的写字板。林在布置前仔细阅读记录。记录显示摊位分配在最后一刻被更改，经理承认蜂蜜卖家的一位朋友得到了林原本的角落位置。新位置是靠近厕所的狭窄阴凉处，没有电源插座。林折起写字板上的记录，然后放下，要求经理撤销更改，但经理耸耸肩走开了。

text_en: Lin, a small-batch jam maker, arrives at the city farmers market at 7 a.m. with a cooler of jars. The market manager hands over the stall assignment and a clipboard with inspection notes. Lin reads the notes carefully before setting up. The notes say the market is ending its lease at the end of the month, and this will be the final farmers market at this location. Lin has sold here every Saturday for five years, and many regulars have become friends. Lin stands still for a moment, then begins to pack the jars back into the cooler, deciding not to set up after all.
text_zh: 林，一位小批量果酱制作者，早上7点到达城市农夫市集，带着一箱罐子。市场经理递过摊位分配单和一块夹着检查记录的写字板。林在布置前仔细阅读记录。记录显示市场将在本月底结束租约，这是该地点的最后一次农夫市集。林五年来每周六都在这里售卖，许多常客已成了朋友。林静静站了一会儿，然后开始把罐子装回冷藏箱，决定干脆不摆摊了。

text_en: Lin, a small-batch jam maker, arrives at the city farmers market at 7 a.m. with a cooler of jars. The market manager hands over the stall assignment and a clipboard with inspection notes. Lin reads the notes carefully before setting up. The notes list the stall number, the time for setup, and a reminder to keep the tablecloth clean. Lin checks the map, walks to the assigned spot, and places the cooler on the table. Then Lin unpacks the jars one by one, arranging them in rows, and waits for the first customers to arrive.
text_zh: 林，一位小批量果酱制作者，早上7点到达城市农夫市集，带着一箱罐子。市场经理递过摊位分配单和一块夹着检查记录的写字板。林在布置前仔细阅读记录。记录列出了摊位号、布置时间，以及保持桌布清洁的提醒。林查看地图，走到分配的摊位，把冷藏箱放在桌上。然后林一罐一罐地取出果酱，排成行，等待第一批顾客到来。

text_en: At 9 PM, Leo arrives at the club's rooftop observatory for his reserved telescope session. He reviews the observation plan on the clipboard: first target is the Orion Nebula, then Saturn. The sky is clear, and the equipment is ready. He adjusts the eyepiece and waits for the scheduled start time. As Leo begins tracking the nebula, the club director walks over and hands him a certificate for the 'Best New Observer' award, along with a voucher for free access to the advanced telescope next month. The director mentions that Leo's meticulous notes from last week impressed the committee. Leo immediately updates his calendar to block out next month's session dates.
text_zh: 晚上9点，Leo来到俱乐部屋顶天文台，参加他预约的望远镜观测时段。他查看夹板上的观测计划：第一个目标是猎户座星云，然后是土星。天空晴朗，设备已准备好。他调整目镜，等待预定开始时间。当Leo开始追踪星云时，俱乐部主任走过来，递给他一张“最佳新观察者”奖状，以及一张下个月高级望远镜免费使用券。主任提到，Leo上周细致的笔记给委员会留下了深刻印象。Leo立刻在日历上标记下个月的观测日期。

text_en: At 9 PM, Leo arrives at the club's rooftop observatory for his reserved telescope session. He reviews the observation plan on the clipboard: first target is the Orion Nebula, then Saturn. The sky is clear, and the equipment is ready. He adjusts the eyepiece and waits for the scheduled start time. Leo had been told the telescope was calibrated for the nebula, but when he looks through the eyepiece, he sees a bright, fast-moving object crossing the field—clearly not a star. He checks the plan: no satellite passes were scheduled. He quickly reorients the scope to follow it, wondering what it could be, and notes its coordinates for later analysis.
text_zh: 晚上9点，Leo来到俱乐部屋顶天文台，参加他预约的望远镜观测时段。他查看夹板上的观测计划：第一个目标是猎户座星云，然后是土星。天空晴朗，设备已准备好。他调整目镜，等待预定开始时间。Leo被告知望远镜已为星云校准，但当他通过目镜观察时，看到一个明亮、快速移动的物体穿过视野——显然不是恒星。他检查计划：没有安排卫星过境。他迅速重新调整望远镜跟踪它，思考那可能是什么，并记下坐标供后续分析。

text_en: At 9 PM, Leo arrives at the club's rooftop observatory for his reserved telescope session. He reviews the observation plan on the clipboard: first target is the Orion Nebula, then Saturn. The sky is clear, and the equipment is ready. He adjusts the eyepiece and waits for the scheduled start time. While Leo is focusing on Saturn, he hears a loud crack from the mount, and the telescope begins to tilt dangerously toward the edge of the platform. The safety latch is not engaged. Leo grabs the tripod leg to steady it, but the weight shifts further. He shouts for help, realizing the equipment could crash onto the street below.
text_zh: 晚上9点，Leo来到俱乐部屋顶天文台，参加他预约的望远镜观测时段。他查看夹板上的观测计划：第一个目标是猎户座星云，然后是土星。天空晴朗，设备已准备好。他调整目镜，等待预定开始时间。当Leo聚焦土星时，他听到支架发出响亮的断裂声，望远镜开始危险地向平台边缘倾斜。安全锁未扣上。Leo抓住三脚架腿试图稳住，但重量进一步偏移。他大声呼救，意识到设备可能坠落到下方街道。

text_en: At 9 PM, Leo arrives at the club's rooftop observatory for his reserved telescope session. He reviews the observation plan on the clipboard: first target is the Orion Nebula, then Saturn. The sky is clear, and the equipment is ready. He adjusts the eyepiece and waits for the scheduled start time. Leo reaches for the focus knob and feels a sticky, slimy residue coating his fingers. He pulls his hand back and sees a dark, greasy film mixed with what looks like dried insect parts. The eyepiece rim is smeared with the same substance. He wipes his hand on his jacket, but the smell lingers. He steps away to find cleaning supplies before touching anything else.
text_zh: 晚上9点，Leo来到俱乐部屋顶天文台，参加他预约的望远镜观测时段。他查看夹板上的观测计划：第一个目标是猎户座星云，然后是土星。天空晴朗，设备已准备好。他调整目镜，等待预定开始时间。Leo伸手去转调焦旋钮，感到手指上沾了一层黏滑的残留物。他缩回手，看到深色油膜混合着类似干昆虫碎片的东西。目镜边缘也涂着同样的物质。他在夹克上擦手，但气味残留。他走开去找清洁用品，不再碰其他东西。

text_en: At 9 PM, Leo arrives at the club's rooftop observatory for his reserved telescope session. He reviews the observation plan on the clipboard: first target is the Orion Nebula, then Saturn. The sky is clear, and the equipment is ready. He adjusts the eyepiece and waits for the scheduled start time. Leo discovers that the telescope's main mirror is misaligned, and the adjustment screw is stripped—clearly from someone forcing it. The logbook shows that the previous user, a club member named Dan, had noted a problem but did not report it. Leo finds Dan's phone number and calls him, demanding an explanation for leaving the equipment damaged without a warning.
text_zh: 晚上9点，Leo来到俱乐部屋顶天文台，参加他预约的望远镜观测时段。他查看夹板上的观测计划：第一个目标是猎户座星云，然后是土星。天空晴朗，设备已准备好。他调整目镜，等待预定开始时间。Leo发现望远镜主镜未对准，调节螺丝已滑丝——明显是有人强行拧过。日志显示前一位使用者，俱乐部成员Dan，曾记录问题但未上报。Leo找到Dan的电话并打给他，要求解释为何留下损坏设备而不警告。

text_en: At 9 PM, Leo arrives at the club's rooftop observatory for his reserved telescope session. He reviews the observation plan on the clipboard: first target is the Orion Nebula, then Saturn. The sky is clear, and the equipment is ready. He adjusts the eyepiece and waits for the scheduled start time. Leo checks the plan again and sees that the Orion Nebula session has been canceled due to a scheduling conflict. The director's note says the slot was reassigned to a school group. Leo's own observation project, which he had planned for weeks, cannot proceed tonight. He packs his notebook and leaves the observatory, knowing the next open slot is two months away.
text_zh: 晚上9点，Leo来到俱乐部屋顶天文台，参加他预约的望远镜观测时段。他查看夹板上的观测计划：第一个目标是猎户座星云，然后是土星。天空晴朗，设备已准备好。他调整目镜，等待预定开始时间。Leo再次查看计划，发现猎户座星云时段因日程冲突被取消。主任的备注说该时段已转给一个学校团体。Leo自己计划了数周的观测项目今晚无法进行。他收拾笔记本离开天文台，知道下一个空档在两个月后。

text_en: At 9 PM, Leo arrives at the club's rooftop observatory for his reserved telescope session. He reviews the observation plan on the clipboard: first target is the Orion Nebula, then Saturn. The sky is clear, and the equipment is ready. He adjusts the eyepiece and waits for the scheduled start time. Leo begins the session as planned. He locates the Orion Nebula, adjusts the focus, and records the brightness in his log. Then he moves to Saturn, noting the ring tilt. The session proceeds without any issues. At the end, he closes the dome, signs the logbook, and heads home, planning to review the data tomorrow.
text_zh: 晚上9点，Leo来到俱乐部屋顶天文台，参加他预约的望远镜观测时段。他查看夹板上的观测计划：第一个目标是猎户座星云，然后是土星。天空晴朗，设备已准备好。他调整目镜，等待预定开始时间。Leo按计划开始观测。他找到猎户座星云，调整焦距，在日志中记录亮度。然后转向土星，记录环倾角。观测过程没有出现任何问题。结束时，他关闭圆顶，签好日志，回家，打算明天查看数据。

text_en: A homeowner meets an auditor in the living room to review the results of a home energy inspection. The auditor has a folder with charts and a checklist. The homeowner wants to know where the house loses heat and what repairs would help. The auditor points to a chart showing that the new insulation in the attic has cut heat loss by forty percent. The homeowner calculates the annual savings on the heating bill and finds it covers the cost of the insulation within two years. The homeowner then asks the auditor for a list of additional upgrades that could bring similar returns.
text_zh: 一位房主在客厅与审计员会面，查看家庭能源检查的结果。审计员拿着一个装有图表和检查清单的文件夹。房主想知道房屋在哪里损失热量，以及哪些维修会有帮助。审计员指着图表显示，阁楼的新保温层已将热量损失减少了百分之四十。房主计算了每年取暖费的节省，发现两年内就能覆盖保温层的成本。房主随后请审计员列出其他能带来类似回报的升级项目。

text_en: A homeowner meets an auditor in the living room to review the results of a home energy inspection. The auditor has a folder with charts and a checklist. The homeowner wants to know where the house loses heat and what repairs would help. The auditor flips to a page that shows the inspection found a hidden duct leak behind the kitchen wall, a problem the homeowner had never suspected. The auditor explains that the leak was not mentioned in the previous report because it was behind a sealed panel. The homeowner rechecks the old report and sees no trace of that duct.
text_zh: 一位房主在客厅与审计员会面，查看家庭能源检查的结果。审计员拿着一个装有图表和检查清单的文件夹。房主想知道房屋在哪里损失热量，以及哪些维修会有帮助。审计员翻到一页，显示检查发现厨房墙后有一个隐藏的风管泄漏，这是房主从未怀疑过的问题。审计员解释说，之前的报告没有提到这个泄漏，因为它位于密封面板后面。房主重新查看旧报告，发现完全没有提到那个风管。

text_en: A homeowner meets an auditor in the living room to review the results of a home energy inspection. The auditor has a folder with charts and a checklist. The homeowner wants to know where the house loses heat and what repairs would help. The auditor points to a reading from the basement showing carbon monoxide levels above the safe threshold. The auditor says the furnace has a crack that could worsen quickly, and the gas could spread through the house within hours. The homeowner immediately turns off the furnace and calls an emergency repair service.
text_zh: 一位房主在客厅与审计员会面，查看家庭能源检查的结果。审计员拿着一个装有图表和检查清单的文件夹。房主想知道房屋在哪里损失热量，以及哪些维修会有帮助。审计员指着地下室的读数，显示一氧化碳水平超过了安全阈值。审计员说炉子有一条裂缝，可能迅速恶化，气体可能在几小时内扩散到整个房子。房主立即关闭炉子，并打电话给紧急维修服务。

text_en: A homeowner meets an auditor in the living room to review the results of a home energy inspection. The auditor has a folder with charts and a checklist. The homeowner wants to know where the house loses heat and what repairs would help. The auditor opens the folder and a strong musty odor comes from the photos of the crawl space. The photos show a thick layer of mold covering the insulation and a dead rodent in the corner. The homeowner steps back from the folder and asks the auditor to close it, then opens a window.
text_zh: 一位房主在客厅与审计员会面，查看家庭能源检查的结果。审计员拿着一个装有图表和检查清单的文件夹。房主想知道房屋在哪里损失热量，以及哪些维修会有帮助。审计员打开文件夹，一股浓重的霉味从爬行空间的照片中散发出来。照片显示保温层上覆盖着厚厚一层霉菌，角落里有一只死啮齿动物。房主后退一步，请审计员合上文件夹，然后打开窗户。

text_en: A homeowner meets an auditor in the living room to review the results of a home energy inspection. The auditor has a folder with charts and a checklist. The homeowner wants to know where the house loses heat and what repairs would help. The auditor explains that the previous contractor, hired last year, installed the insulation incorrectly and left gaps that caused the heat loss. The auditor shows a photo of the gaps and notes that the contractor had been paid in full despite the faulty work. The homeowner calls the contractor's office to demand a refund.
text_zh: 一位房主在客厅与审计员会面，查看家庭能源检查的结果。审计员拿着一个装有图表和检查清单的文件夹。房主想知道房屋在哪里损失热量，以及哪些维修会有帮助。审计员解释说，去年雇用的承包商安装保温层不当，留下了导致热量损失的缝隙。审计员展示了缝隙的照片，并指出尽管工作有缺陷，承包商还是得到了全额付款。房主打电话给承包商办公室要求退款。

text_en: A homeowner meets an auditor in the living room to review the results of a home energy inspection. The auditor has a folder with charts and a checklist. The homeowner wants to know where the house loses heat and what repairs would help. The auditor shows that the old furnace has reached the end of its lifespan and cannot be repaired. The homeowner had hoped to keep the house for many more years, but the replacement cost is more than the savings they have. The homeowner sits down and looks at the estimate, then puts it aside.
text_zh: 一位房主在客厅与审计员会面，查看家庭能源检查的结果。审计员拿着一个装有图表和检查清单的文件夹。房主想知道房屋在哪里损失热量，以及哪些维修会有帮助。审计员显示旧炉子已达到使用寿命，无法修复。房主原本希望还能在这所房子里住很多年，但更换费用超过了他们的积蓄。房主坐下来看着估价单，然后把它放到一边。

text_en: A homeowner meets an auditor in the living room to review the results of a home energy inspection. The auditor has a folder with charts and a checklist. The homeowner wants to know where the house loses heat and what repairs would help. The auditor reviews the checklist and notes that the windows are in average condition, with no major leaks or drafts. The auditor says the current insulation is adequate for the climate. The homeowner thanks the auditor and asks for a copy of the report to keep for future reference.
text_zh: 一位房主在客厅与审计员会面，查看家庭能源检查的结果。审计员拿着一个装有图表和检查清单的文件夹。房主想知道房屋在哪里损失热量，以及哪些维修会有帮助。审计员检查了清单，指出窗户状况一般，没有大的泄漏或穿堂风。审计员说目前的保温层适合当地气候。房主感谢审计员，并要了一份报告副本以备将来参考。

text_en: Ming walks into the rehearsal hall at 6:30 PM, music folder under one arm. On the bulletin board, the conductor has posted the solo assignments for Saturday’s concert. Ming reads the list carefully, noting each name next to the corresponding piece. Ming’s name appears beside the opening aria, the piece he had practiced every evening for two months. He had hoped for this chance, and now it is his. He pulls out his score and begins marking the phrasing, planning to run through it once more before the others arrive.
text_zh: 明在晚上六点半走进排练厅，胳膊下夹着乐谱夹。布告栏上，指挥贴出了周六音乐会的独唱分配名单。明仔细阅读名单，把每个名字和对应的曲目一一记下。明的名字出现在开场咏叹调旁边，那正是他两个月来每晚练习的曲目。他一直盼着这个机会，现在终于轮到他了。他抽出乐谱，开始标注乐句，打算在其他人到来之前再完整过一遍。

text_en: Ming walks into the rehearsal hall at 6:30 PM, music folder under one arm. On the bulletin board, the conductor has posted the solo assignments for Saturday’s concert. Ming reads the list carefully, noting each name next to the corresponding piece. Ming’s name is listed for the closing duet, but he had been told last week that the conductor had chosen two other singers for that piece. He reads the line again, then checks the date at the top of the page to make sure it is today’s notice. He walks over to the conductor’s office to ask about the change.
text_zh: 明在晚上六点半走进排练厅，胳膊下夹着乐谱夹。布告栏上，指挥贴出了周六音乐会的独唱分配名单。明仔细阅读名单，把每个名字和对应的曲目一一记下。明的名字被列在结尾二重唱旁边，但上周他刚听说指挥已经选了另外两位歌手来唱这首曲子。他又读了一遍名单，然后核对页面顶部的日期，确认这是今天的通知。他走向指挥办公室，想问清楚这个变动。

text_en: Ming walks into the rehearsal hall at 6:30 PM, music folder under one arm. On the bulletin board, the conductor has posted the solo assignments for Saturday’s concert. Ming reads the list carefully, noting each name next to the corresponding piece. Ming’s name is not on the list, but a handwritten note below says that all members must pass a private sight-reading check tomorrow evening, and anyone who fails will be removed from the concert. Ming has never been good at sight-reading. He looks at the clock, then opens his folder to find the new piece he has not yet practiced.
text_zh: 明在晚上六点半走进排练厅，胳膊下夹着乐谱夹。布告栏上，指挥贴出了周六音乐会的独唱分配名单。明仔细阅读名单，把每个名字和对应的曲目一一记下。名单上没有明的名字，但下方有一行手写备注：所有成员明晚必须通过一次私下视唱考核，未通过者将被移出音乐会。明向来不擅长视唱。他看了一眼时钟，然后打开乐谱夹，找出那首他还没练过的新曲子。

text_en: Ming walks into the rehearsal hall at 6:30 PM, music folder under one arm. On the bulletin board, the conductor has posted the solo assignments for Saturday’s concert. Ming reads the list carefully, noting each name next to the corresponding piece. Ming’s name is listed for the alto part, but the paper has a large coffee stain spreading across the middle, and the edge of the page is sticky with dried syrup from someone’s drink. He pulls his hand back, then wipes his fingers on his pant leg. He steps away from the board, looking for a clean copy of the list.
text_zh: 明在晚上六点半走进排练厅，胳膊下夹着乐谱夹。布告栏上，指挥贴出了周六音乐会的独唱分配名单。明仔细阅读名单，把每个名字和对应的曲目一一记下。明的名字被列在中音声部，但纸上有一大片咖啡渍蔓延在中间，纸的边缘还粘着某人饮料留下的干糖浆。他缩回手，然后在裤腿上擦了擦手指。他退离布告栏，想找一份干净的名单副本。

text_en: Ming walks into the rehearsal hall at 6:30 PM, music folder under one arm. On the bulletin board, the conductor has posted the solo assignments for Saturday’s concert. Ming reads the list carefully, noting each name next to the corresponding piece. Ming’s name is missing from the list, but he sees that the conductor’s nephew, who joined the choir only last month and has missed three rehearsals, has been given the solo Ming was promised in last week’s email. Ming rereads the email on his phone, then looks at the board again. He folds his arms and waits for the conductor to arrive.
text_zh: 明在晚上六点半走进排练厅，胳膊下夹着乐谱夹。布告栏上，指挥贴出了周六音乐会的独唱分配名单。明仔细阅读名单，把每个名字和对应的曲目一一记下。名单上没有明的名字，但他看到指挥的侄子——上个月才加入合唱团、还缺席了三次排练——被分到了明上周邮件里被承诺的独唱。明重新看了手机里的邮件，又看了看布告栏。他双臂交叉，等着指挥到来。

text_en: Ming walks into the rehearsal hall at 6:30 PM, music folder under one arm. On the bulletin board, the conductor has posted the solo assignments for Saturday’s concert. Ming reads the list carefully, noting each name next to the corresponding piece. Ming’s name is not on the list, and neither is the name of his friend, who had practiced the same duet with him for weeks. The conductor has replaced that duet with a new piece, and the list shows only a single soloist. Ming looks at the empty space where his friend’s name should have been, then closes his folder and walks to his usual seat without speaking.
text_zh: 明在晚上六点半走进排练厅，胳膊下夹着乐谱夹。布告栏上，指挥贴出了周六音乐会的独唱分配名单。明仔细阅读名单，把每个名字和对应的曲目一一记下。名单上没有明的名字，也没有他朋友的名字——那位朋友几周来一直和他一起练习同一首二重唱。指挥用一首新曲子替换了那首二重唱，名单上只显示一位独唱者。明看着朋友名字本该出现的那片空白，然后合上乐谱夹，一言不发地走向自己常坐的位置。

text_en: Ming walks into the rehearsal hall at 6:30 PM, music folder under one arm. On the bulletin board, the conductor has posted the solo assignments for Saturday’s concert. Ming reads the list carefully, noting each name next to the corresponding piece. Ming’s name appears in the chorus section, as it did for the previous concert. The rehearsal schedule is printed below the list, and Ming notes that the first full run-through is set for Thursday. He checks his calendar, confirms he is free, and then sits down to warm up his voice with the rest of the group.
text_zh: 明在晚上六点半走进排练厅，胳膊下夹着乐谱夹。布告栏上，指挥贴出了周六音乐会的独唱分配名单。明仔细阅读名单，把每个名字和对应的曲目一一记下。明的名字出现在合唱声部，和上次音乐会一样。排练时间表印在名单下方，明注意到第一次完整联排安排在周四。他查了查日历，确认自己有空，然后坐下来和其他成员一起开嗓。

text_en: At the city aquarium, technician Lin checks the morning report for the coral reef tank. The water sample was taken yesterday, and the lab results have just arrived. Lin reviews the parameters to decide if any adjustments are needed before the public viewing hours begin. The analysis shows that all levels are ideal: pH, salinity, and nitrate are exactly within the target range. The coral polyps have been extending fully, and the fish are active. Lin closes the report and heads to the tank to prepare the morning feed, knowing the habitat is thriving.
text_zh: 在市水族馆，技师林查看珊瑚礁水箱的晨间报告。水样是昨天采集的，实验室结果刚刚送达。林查看各项参数，以决定在公众参观时段开始前是否需要调整。分析显示所有指标都理想：pH值、盐度和硝酸盐正好在目标范围内。珊瑚虫完全伸展，鱼类活跃。林合上报告，前往水箱准备晨间喂食，知道这个栖息地正在蓬勃生长。

text_en: At the city aquarium, technician Lin checks the morning report for the coral reef tank. The water sample was taken yesterday, and the lab results have just arrived. Lin reviews the parameters to decide if any adjustments are needed before the public viewing hours begin. The analysis shows a calcium level nearly double the usual reading, a value never seen in this tank before. Lin double-checks the printout, then recalibrates the probe and runs a new test. The result remains the same, prompting Lin to call the lab to verify the sample's origin.
text_zh: 在市水族馆，技师林查看珊瑚礁水箱的晨间报告。水样是昨天采集的，实验室结果刚刚送达。林查看各项参数，以决定在公众参观时段开始前是否需要调整。分析显示钙含量几乎是平时读数的两倍，这个数值在这个水箱中从未出现过。林反复核对打印结果，然后重新校准探头并重新测试。结果依然相同，林于是打电话给实验室核实样本来源。

text_en: At the city aquarium, technician Lin checks the morning report for the coral reef tank. The water sample was taken yesterday, and the lab results have just arrived. Lin reviews the parameters to decide if any adjustments are needed before the public viewing hours begin. The analysis detects a sharp rise in ammonia, now at a level that could harm the fish within hours. Lin's hands move quickly to activate the emergency filtration system and check the backup pump. The safety of the entire tank depends on how fast the system can cycle the water.
text_zh: 在市水族馆，技师林查看珊瑚礁水箱的晨间报告。水样是昨天采集的，实验室结果刚刚送达。林查看各项参数，以决定在公众参观时段开始前是否需要调整。分析检测到氨含量急剧上升，已达到可能在数小时内伤害鱼类的水平。林迅速启动应急过滤系统并检查备用泵。整个水箱的安全取决于系统循环水的速度。

text_en: At the city aquarium, technician Lin checks the morning report for the coral reef tank. The water sample was taken yesterday, and the lab results have just arrived. Lin reviews the parameters to decide if any adjustments are needed before the public viewing hours begin. The analysis reveals a high concentration of organic waste and a foul odor emanating from the sample. Lin notices a slimy film on the water surface and decomposing food particles at the bottom. The tank needs immediate cleaning, and Lin puts on gloves to begin removing the contaminated material.
text_zh: 在市水族馆，技师林查看珊瑚礁水箱的晨间报告。水样是昨天采集的，实验室结果刚刚送达。林查看各项参数，以决定在公众参观时段开始前是否需要调整。分析显示有机废物浓度很高，样本散发出难闻气味。林注意到水面有粘滑薄膜，底部有腐烂的食物颗粒。水箱需要立即清洁，林戴上手套开始清除受污染的物质。

text_en: At the city aquarium, technician Lin checks the morning report for the coral reef tank. The water sample was taken yesterday, and the lab results have just arrived. Lin reviews the parameters to decide if any adjustments are needed before the public viewing hours begin. The analysis shows that the water is contaminated with a cleaning chemical, despite the label stating it was pure. Lin recalls that a supplier recently switched brands without notice. This negligence could have harmed the animals, so Lin gathers the evidence and heads to the supervisor's office to demand an explanation.
text_zh: 在市水族馆，技师林查看珊瑚礁水箱的晨间报告。水样是昨天采集的，实验室结果刚刚送达。林查看各项参数，以决定在公众参观时段开始前是否需要调整。分析显示水被一种清洁化学品污染，尽管标签上标明是纯净的。林想起供应商最近未经通知就更换了品牌。这种疏忽本可能伤害动物，于是林收集证据，前往主管办公室要求解释。

text_en: At the city aquarium, technician Lin checks the morning report for the coral reef tank. The water sample was taken yesterday, and the lab results have just arrived. Lin reviews the parameters to decide if any adjustments are needed before the public viewing hours begin. The analysis confirms that the water's pH has dropped irreversibly, and the delicate coral colonies have already begun to bleach. Despite all efforts, the damage is done. Lin marks the tank for quarantine and begins the slow process of documenting the loss, knowing the habitat will not recover.
text_zh: 在市水族馆，技师林查看珊瑚礁水箱的晨间报告。水样是昨天采集的，实验室结果刚刚送达。林查看各项参数，以决定在公众参观时段开始前是否需要调整。分析确认水的pH值已不可逆地下降，脆弱的珊瑚群落已经开始白化。尽管尽了全力，损害已经造成。林标记水箱进行隔离，并开始缓慢记录损失，知道这个栖息地无法恢复。

text_en: At the city aquarium, technician Lin checks the morning report for the coral reef tank. The water sample was taken yesterday, and the lab results have just arrived. Lin reviews the parameters to decide if any adjustments are needed before the public viewing hours begin. The analysis shows that the water parameters are within the normal range, matching the previous month's results. Lin notes the values in the logbook and proceeds with the routine water change scheduled for today. The tank continues to operate as expected, with no further action required.
text_zh: 在市水族馆，技师林查看珊瑚礁水箱的晨间报告。水样是昨天采集的，实验室结果刚刚送达。林查看各项参数，以决定在公众参观时段开始前是否需要调整。分析显示水质参数在正常范围内，与上个月的结果一致。林将数值记录在日志中，并按计划进行今天的例行换水。水箱照常运行，无需额外操作。

text_en: A woodworker meets a client who has come to inspect a newly completed custom table. The table was built to the client's exact specifications over three weeks. The workshop smells of fresh varnish and sawdust. The client walks around the table, running a hand along the edge. The woodworker waits for a response. The client stops, then pulls out a folded check and places it on the table. "The grain matches the sample perfectly," they say, and add a generous bonus on top of the agreed price. The woodworker's next project is fully funded, and they immediately call their supplier to order the rare walnut they had been eyeing for months.
text_zh: 一位木匠接待了一位前来检查刚完成的定制桌子的客户。这张桌子是按照客户的确切规格花了三周时间制作的。工坊里弥漫着清漆和木屑的气味。客户绕着桌子走，用手沿着边缘滑动。木匠等待着回应。客户停下来，然后掏出一张折叠的支票放在桌上。“木纹和样品完全匹配，”他们说，并在商定价格上又加了一笔可观的奖金。木匠的下一个项目资金完全到位，他立刻给供应商打电话，订购那批他觊觎了好几个月的稀有胡桃木。

text_en: A woodworker meets a client who has come to inspect a newly completed custom table. The table was built to the client's exact specifications over three weeks. The workshop smells of fresh varnish and sawdust. The client walks around the table, running a hand along the edge. The woodworker waits for a response. The client steps back and says, "This is not what I ordered. I asked for a drawer on the left side, but you built it on the right." The woodworker checks the original sketch—it clearly shows the drawer on the right. The client pulls out a different contract, dated a week later, with the left-side specification. The woodworker has never seen that document before.
text_zh: 一位木匠接待了一位前来检查刚完成的定制桌子的客户。这张桌子是按照客户的确切规格花了三周时间制作的。工坊里弥漫着清漆和木屑的气味。客户绕着桌子走，用手沿着边缘滑动。木匠等待着回应。客户后退一步说：“这不是我订的。我要求抽屉在左边，但你做在了右边。”木匠检查了原始草图——上面清楚显示抽屉在右边。客户拿出一份不同的合同，日期晚了一周，上面写着左边规格。木匠从未见过那份文件。

text_en: A woodworker meets a client who has come to inspect a newly completed custom table. The table was built to the client's exact specifications over three weeks. The workshop smells of fresh varnish and sawdust. The client walks around the table, running a hand along the edge. The woodworker waits for a response. The client's phone rings. They answer, listen, and their face goes pale. "The police are outside," they whisper. "They found a body in the woods near your supplier's yard. They're asking everyone who used that wood to come in for questioning." The woodworker's hands freeze on the table edge. The varnish smell suddenly seems too strong.
text_zh: 一位木匠接待了一位前来检查刚完成的定制桌子的客户。这张桌子是按照客户的确切规格花了三周时间制作的。工坊里弥漫着清漆和木屑的气味。客户绕着桌子走，用手沿着边缘滑动。木匠等待着回应。客户的电话响了。他们接听，听了一下，脸色变得苍白。“警察在外面，”他们低声说。“他们在你供应商的院子附近的树林里发现了一具尸体。他们要求所有用过那批木材的人去接受询问。”木匠的手在桌边僵住了。清漆的气味突然变得太浓了。

text_en: A woodworker meets a client who has come to inspect a newly completed custom table. The table was built to the client's exact specifications over three weeks. The workshop smells of fresh varnish and sawdust. The client walks around the table, running a hand along the edge. The woodworker waits for a response. The client runs a finger along the table's underside and stops. A dark, sticky smear clings to their fingertip. They hold it up—it smells like rotting meat. The woodworker looks closer and sees a small, soft patch of mold growing in a joint, oozing a brown liquid. The client wipes their hand on their coat, leaving a stain.
text_zh: 一位木匠接待了一位前来检查刚完成的定制桌子的客户。这张桌子是按照客户的确切规格花了三周时间制作的。工坊里弥漫着清漆和木屑的气味。客户绕着桌子走，用手沿着边缘滑动。木匠等待着回应。客户沿着桌子底部滑动手指，然后停住了。指尖上沾着一道深色黏稠的污迹。他们举起手——闻起来像腐肉。木匠凑近一看，发现接缝处长了一小片软软的霉菌，渗出棕色液体。客户在衣服上擦了擦手，留下了一块污渍。

text_en: A woodworker meets a client who has come to inspect a newly completed custom table. The table was built to the client's exact specifications over three weeks. The workshop smells of fresh varnish and sawdust. The client walks around the table, running a hand along the edge. The woodworker waits for a response. The client points at a small scratch near the leg. "You did this," they say. "I saw you drag a metal crate across the floor yesterday. You knew it would damage the finish." The woodworker explains it was a pre-existing mark from the supplier, but the client cuts them off. "I'm deducting the repair cost from your final payment. And I'm leaving a bad review."
text_zh: 一位木匠接待了一位前来检查刚完成的定制桌子的客户。这张桌子是按照客户的确切规格花了三周时间制作的。工坊里弥漫着清漆和木屑的气味。客户绕着桌子走，用手沿着边缘滑动。木匠等待着回应。客户指着桌腿附近的一道小划痕。“你干的，”他们说。“我昨天看见你拖着金属箱在地板上拖过。你知道这会损坏漆面。”木匠解释说这是供应商之前就有的痕迹，但客户打断了他。“我要从尾款里扣掉维修费。而且我要留下差评。”

text_en: A woodworker meets a client who has come to inspect a newly completed custom table. The table was built to the client's exact specifications over three weeks. The workshop smells of fresh varnish and sawdust. The client walks around the table, running a hand along the edge. The woodworker waits for a response. The client looks at the table, then at the woodworker. "My wife designed this table with me," they say quietly. "She passed away last Tuesday. I had hoped to see her sketch come to life, but now I can't even look at it without remembering she's gone." The woodworker stands silent. The client turns and walks out, leaving the table untouched.
text_zh: 一位木匠接待了一位前来检查刚完成的定制桌子的客户。这张桌子是按照客户的确切规格花了三周时间制作的。工坊里弥漫着清漆和木屑的气味。客户绕着桌子走，用手沿着边缘滑动。木匠等待着回应。客户看着桌子，又看看木匠。“这张桌子是我妻子和我一起设计的，”他们轻声说。“她上周二去世了。我本希望看到她的草图变成现实，但现在我甚至无法看着它而不想起她已经不在了。”木匠沉默地站着。客户转身走了出去，没有碰那张桌子。

text_en: A woodworker meets a client who has come to inspect a newly completed custom table. The table was built to the client's exact specifications over three weeks. The workshop smells of fresh varnish and sawdust. The client walks around the table, running a hand along the edge. The woodworker waits for a response. The client completes a full circle around the table, then nods. "It matches the dimensions we agreed on. The finish is even. I'll take it." They write a standard check for the exact amount and hand it over. The woodworker confirms the delivery address. They exchange a brief handshake, and the client leaves. The workshop returns to its usual quiet.
text_zh: 一位木匠接待了一位前来检查刚完成的定制桌子的客户。这张桌子是按照客户的确切规格花了三周时间制作的。工坊里弥漫着清漆和木屑的气味。客户绕着桌子走，用手沿着边缘滑动。木匠等待着回应。客户绕着桌子走完一圈，然后点点头。“尺寸和我们商定的一致。漆面均匀。我买了。”他们开了一张标准金额的支票递过去。木匠确认了送货地址。他们简短地握了握手，客户离开了。工坊恢复了往常的安静。

text_en: Lin arrives at the ferry terminal at 9 PM for an overnight crossing. At the check-in counter, the agent scans the ticket and looks up the cabin assignment. The agent pauses, then reads out the cabin number and details. Lin listens carefully, holding a small overnight bag. The agent says, 'You've been upgraded to a deluxe suite with a private balcony and a king-size bed.' Lin had only booked a standard inside cabin, so this is a rare bonus. The suite also includes a complimentary dinner voucher and priority boarding. Lin immediately texts a friend to share the good news, then heads toward the boarding gate with a lighter step.
text_zh: 晚上九点，林到达渡轮码头，准备搭乘过夜航班。在办理登船手续的柜台，工作人员扫描了船票并查找舱房分配。工作人员停顿了一下，然后读出舱房号和详细信息。林仔细听着，手里提着一个小的过夜包。工作人员说：“您已被升级到豪华套房，带私人阳台和特大号床。”林只预订了标准内舱，所以这是难得的额外收获。套房还包含免费晚餐券和优先登船权。林立刻给朋友发信息分享这个好消息，然后脚步轻快地走向登船口。

text_en: Lin arrives at the ferry terminal at 9 PM for an overnight crossing. At the check-in counter, the agent scans the ticket and looks up the cabin assignment. The agent pauses, then reads out the cabin number and details. Lin listens carefully, holding a small overnight bag. The agent says, 'Your cabin is number 7A, which is the same number you had on your last trip.' Lin had not mentioned that to anyone, and the ticket system had no record of it. The agent shrugs, saying it was just a random assignment. Lin stares at the ticket, trying to recall if they had ever booked that cabin before, but cannot remember doing so.
text_zh: 晚上九点，林到达渡轮码头，准备搭乘过夜航班。在办理登船手续的柜台，工作人员扫描了船票并查找舱房分配。工作人员停顿了一下，然后读出舱房号和详细信息。林仔细听着，手里提着一个小的过夜包。工作人员说：“您的舱房是7A，和您上次旅行时住的号码一样。”林从未向任何人提过这件事，票务系统里也没有记录。工作人员耸耸肩，说这只是随机分配。林盯着船票，努力回想是否曾订过那个舱房，但记不起来了。

text_en: Lin arrives at the ferry terminal at 9 PM for an overnight crossing. At the check-in counter, the agent scans the ticket and looks up the cabin assignment. The agent pauses, then reads out the cabin number and details. Lin listens carefully, holding a small overnight bag. The agent says, 'Your cabin is on Deck 3, near the engine room. There was a small fire there last week, but it's been fixed.' Lin's stomach tightens. The agent adds that the fire alarm system is still being tested. Lin looks toward the gangway, considering whether to cancel the trip and find a hotel instead, but the ferry is the only way to reach the morning meeting.
text_zh: 晚上九点，林到达渡轮码头，准备搭乘过夜航班。在办理登船手续的柜台，工作人员扫描了船票并查找舱房分配。工作人员停顿了一下，然后读出舱房号和详细信息。林仔细听着，手里提着一个小的过夜包。工作人员说：“您的舱房在3层甲板，靠近发动机室。上周那里发生过一次小火，但已经修好了。”林的心一紧。工作人员补充说，火灾报警系统还在测试中。林看向登船梯，考虑是否取消行程改住酒店，但渡轮是赶上早间会议的唯一方式。

text_en: Lin arrives at the ferry terminal at 9 PM for an overnight crossing. At the check-in counter, the agent scans the ticket and looks up the cabin assignment. The agent pauses, then reads out the cabin number and details. Lin listens carefully, holding a small overnight bag. The agent says, 'Your cabin is ready, but the previous passenger left a used bandage on the pillow. We'll change the sheets, but the mattress may still have a stain.' Lin's nose wrinkles at the thought. The agent offers a spray to mask the smell. Lin asks for a different cabin, but the agent says none are available, so Lin decides to buy a new pillow cover from the shop.
text_zh: 晚上九点，林到达渡轮码头，准备搭乘过夜航班。在办理登船手续的柜台，工作人员扫描了船票并查找舱房分配。工作人员停顿了一下，然后读出舱房号和详细信息。林仔细听着，手里提着一个小的过夜包。工作人员说：“您的舱房已准备好，但上一位乘客在枕头上留下了一个用过的创可贴。我们会更换床单，但床垫上可能还有污渍。”林一想到这个就皱起鼻子。工作人员提供了一瓶喷雾来掩盖气味。林要求换一间舱房，但工作人员说没有空房，于是林决定从商店买一个新的枕套。

text_en: Lin arrives at the ferry terminal at 9 PM for an overnight crossing. At the check-in counter, the agent scans the ticket and looks up the cabin assignment. The agent pauses, then reads out the cabin number and details. Lin listens carefully, holding a small overnight bag. The agent says, 'Your cabin is on Deck 5, but the elevator is out of order, and the stairs are blocked by luggage. You'll have to climb via the emergency ladder.' Lin had specifically requested a ground-level cabin due to a knee injury, and the agent had confirmed it. Now the agent shrugs, saying it's not their problem. Lin demands a refund, but the agent refuses.
text_zh: 晚上九点，林到达渡轮码头，准备搭乘过夜航班。在办理登船手续的柜台，工作人员扫描了船票并查找舱房分配。工作人员停顿了一下，然后读出舱房号和详细信息。林仔细听着，手里提着一个小的过夜包。工作人员说：“您的舱房在5层甲板，但电梯坏了，楼梯被行李堵住。您只能通过紧急梯子爬上去。”林因膝盖受伤曾特别要求低层舱房，工作人员当时也确认了。现在工作人员耸耸肩，说这不是他们的问题。林要求退款，但工作人员拒绝了。

text_en: Lin arrives at the ferry terminal at 9 PM for an overnight crossing. At the check-in counter, the agent scans the ticket and looks up the cabin assignment. The agent pauses, then reads out the cabin number and details. Lin listens carefully, holding a small overnight bag. The agent says, 'Your cabin is number 12, but I'm sorry, the ferry has been overbooked, and your cabin was reassigned to a family with a child. You'll have to stay in the common lounge.' Lin had booked this cabin months ago for a quiet night before a funeral. Now the lounge is noisy and bright. Lin quietly walks away, holding the ticket that no longer means anything.
text_zh: 晚上九点，林到达渡轮码头，准备搭乘过夜航班。在办理登船手续的柜台，工作人员扫描了船票并查找舱房分配。工作人员停顿了一下，然后读出舱房号和详细信息。林仔细听着，手里提着一个小的过夜包。工作人员说：“您的舱房是12号，但很抱歉，渡轮超售了，您的舱房被重新分配给了带孩子的家庭。您只能待在公共休息室。”林几个月前就订了这个舱房，想在参加葬礼前安静地度过一夜。现在休息室又吵又亮。林默默走开，手里攥着那张已无意义的船票。

text_en: Lin arrives at the ferry terminal at 9 PM for an overnight crossing. At the check-in counter, the agent scans the ticket and looks up the cabin assignment. The agent pauses, then reads out the cabin number and details. Lin listens carefully, holding a small overnight bag. The agent says, 'Your cabin is number 15, on Deck 2. It's a standard inside cabin with two bunk beds and a small washbasin. The key card is here. Boarding starts in twenty minutes.' Lin nods, takes the key card, and checks the cabin number on the map. Then Lin walks toward the waiting area to sit until boarding is announced.
text_zh: 晚上九点，林到达渡轮码头，准备搭乘过夜航班。在办理登船手续的柜台，工作人员扫描了船票并查找舱房分配。工作人员停顿了一下，然后读出舱房号和详细信息。林仔细听着，手里提着一个小的过夜包。工作人员说：“您的舱房是15号，在2层甲板。这是一间标准内舱，有两张双层床和一个小洗手盆。房卡在这里。二十分钟后开始登船。”林点点头，接过房卡，在地图上确认了舱房号。然后林走向等候区坐下，等待登船通知。

text_en: Lin had reserved a campsite at Pine Ridge for the weekend. After setting up the tent, a ranger arrived to inspect the site. Lin waited by the picnic table while the ranger checked the fire pit, tent placement, and food storage. The ranger finished the inspection and walked over to Lin. The ranger said the site was in perfect condition and that Lin had followed every rule. The ranger added that Lin’s setup was the best example they had seen all season. The ranger offered Lin a free upgrade to a lakeside spot for the next visit, and wrote a note with the reservation code. Lin began planning which weekend to return.
text_zh: 林在松岭营地预订了一个周末的营位。搭好帐篷后，一名护林员前来检查场地。林在野餐桌旁等候，护林员检查了火坑、帐篷位置和食物存放。护林员检查完毕，走向林。护林员说场地状况完美，林遵守了所有规定。护林员补充说，林的布置是他们整个季节见过的最佳范例。护林员主动提出下次来访可免费升级到湖边营位，并写下一张带有预订码的纸条。林开始计划哪个周末再来。

text_en: Lin had reserved a campsite at Pine Ridge for the weekend. After setting up the tent, a ranger arrived to inspect the site. Lin waited by the picnic table while the ranger checked the fire pit, tent placement, and food storage. The ranger finished the inspection and walked over to Lin. The ranger said the site was approved, but then added that the reservation system had double-booked this spot. Another camper would arrive in an hour. The ranger explained that this had never happened before at Pine Ridge. Lin had expected a simple confirmation, not a scheduling conflict. Lin looked at the tent, then at the ranger’s clipboard.
text_zh: 林在松岭营地预订了一个周末的营位。搭好帐篷后，一名护林员前来检查场地。林在野餐桌旁等候，护林员检查了火坑、帐篷位置和食物存放。护林员检查完毕，走向林。护林员说场地合格，但接着补充说预订系统重复预订了这个营位。一小时后会有另一位露营者到达。护林员解释说松岭以前从未发生过这种情况。林本以为只是简单确认，没想到会有日程冲突。林看看帐篷，又看看护林员的记录板。

text_en: Lin had reserved a campsite at Pine Ridge for the weekend. After setting up the tent, a ranger arrived to inspect the site. Lin waited by the picnic table while the ranger checked the fire pit, tent placement, and food storage. The ranger finished the inspection and walked over to Lin. The ranger pointed to a fresh pile of bear scat near the tree line, only twenty meters from the tent. The ranger said a large bear had been active in this area since dawn. The ranger advised leaving immediately, as the bear might return before dark. Lin glanced at the food bag hanging from the branch and started calculating how fast to pack the car.
text_zh: 林在松岭营地预订了一个周末的营位。搭好帐篷后，一名护林员前来检查场地。林在野餐桌旁等候，护林员检查了火坑、帐篷位置和食物存放。护林员检查完毕，走向林。护林员指着树林边缘一堆新鲜的熊粪，距离帐篷只有二十米。护林员说从黎明起就有一只大熊在这一带活动。护林员建议立即离开，因为熊可能在天黑前返回。林瞥了一眼挂在树枝上的食物袋，开始计算多快能收拾好车。

text_en: Lin had reserved a campsite at Pine Ridge for the weekend. After setting up the tent, a ranger arrived to inspect the site. Lin waited by the picnic table while the ranger checked the fire pit, tent placement, and food storage. The ranger finished the inspection and walked over to Lin. The ranger lifted the tent flap and pointed to a thick layer of mold spreading across the inner floor. A sour, damp smell rose from the fabric. The ranger said the previous camper had left wet gear inside, and the mold had soaked into the seams. Lin pulled back from the opening, then reached for the tent’s zipper to close it again.
text_zh: 林在松岭营地预订了一个周末的营位。搭好帐篷后，一名护林员前来检查场地。林在野餐桌旁等候，护林员检查了火坑、帐篷位置和食物存放。护林员检查完毕，走向林。护林员掀起帐篷门帘，指着内层地板上蔓延的一层厚霉菌。一股酸腐潮湿的气味从布料上升起。护林员说上一位露营者把湿装备留在里面，霉菌已经渗入接缝。林从开口处退后一步，然后伸手拉上帐篷拉链，重新关好。

text_en: Lin had reserved a campsite at Pine Ridge for the weekend. After setting up the tent, a ranger arrived to inspect the site. Lin waited by the picnic table while the ranger checked the fire pit, tent placement, and food storage. The ranger finished the inspection and walked over to Lin. The ranger said the site was fine, but then noted that Lin’s reservation had been canceled by the front office two days ago. The ranger explained that a staff member had mistakenly deleted it, and now the site was already assigned to someone else. Lin had driven three hours and paid the fee in advance. Lin demanded to speak with the office manager.
text_zh: 林在松岭营地预订了一个周末的营位。搭好帐篷后，一名护林员前来检查场地。林在野餐桌旁等候，护林员检查了火坑、帐篷位置和食物存放。护林员检查完毕，走向林。护林员说场地没问题，但接着指出林的预订两天前已被前台取消。护林员解释说一名工作人员误删了预订，现在这个营位已经分配给了别人。林开了三小时车，还预付了费用。林要求与办公室经理谈话。

text_en: Lin had reserved a campsite at Pine Ridge for the weekend. After setting up the tent, a ranger arrived to inspect the site. Lin waited by the picnic table while the ranger checked the fire pit, tent placement, and food storage. The ranger finished the inspection and walked over to Lin. The ranger said the site was approved, but then explained that this would be the last season Pine Ridge would operate. The forest service had decided not to renew the lease, and all reservations after next month would be refunded. The ranger handed Lin a notice with the closure date. Lin folded the paper and looked at the trees around the site.
text_zh: 林在松岭营地预订了一个周末的营位。搭好帐篷后，一名护林员前来检查场地。林在野餐桌旁等候，护林员检查了火坑、帐篷位置和食物存放。护林员检查完毕，走向林。护林员说场地合格，但接着解释说这是松岭运营的最后一个季节。林务局决定不再续租，下个月之后的所有预订都将退款。护林员递给林一张写着关闭日期的通知。林折起纸张，看着营位周围的树木。

text_en: Lin had reserved a campsite at Pine Ridge for the weekend. After setting up the tent, a ranger arrived to inspect the site. Lin waited by the picnic table while the ranger checked the fire pit, tent placement, and food storage. The ranger finished the inspection and walked over to Lin. The ranger said the site met all requirements and checked off the last item on the clipboard. The ranger reminded Lin that quiet hours started at ten and that firewood could be bought at the entrance. The ranger then walked toward the next site. Lin returned to the picnic table and unpacked the cooler.
text_zh: 林在松岭营地预订了一个周末的营位。搭好帐篷后，一名护林员前来检查场地。林在野餐桌旁等候，护林员检查了火坑、帐篷位置和食物存放。护林员检查完毕，走向林。护林员说场地符合所有要求，并在记录板上勾选了最后一项。护林员提醒林安静时段从十点开始，柴火可以在入口处购买。随后护林员走向下一个营位。林回到野餐桌旁，打开冷藏箱。

text_en: A caterer, Lin, has prepared a sample menu for a client at a scheduled tasting. The client is deciding whether to book Lin for a large wedding. Lin has arranged the dishes on a table in the venue's kitchen. The client finishes tasting every dish and then asks for a detailed quote for the full wedding. They mention that the flavors match exactly what they had hoped for. Lin immediately starts drafting the contract, knowing the booking is secured. The client also asks for Lin's business card to share with two other couples.
text_zh: 餐饮承办人林某在预定的品鉴会上为客户准备了一份样品菜单。客户正在决定是否聘请林某承办一场大型婚礼。林某将菜肴摆放在场地厨房的桌子上。客户尝完所有菜肴后，要求提供整场婚礼的详细报价。他们提到口味完全符合他们的期望。林某立即开始起草合同，知道预订已经确定。客户还索要林某的名片，打算分享给另外两对新人。

text_en: A caterer, Lin, has prepared a sample menu for a client at a scheduled tasting. The client is deciding whether to book Lin for a large wedding. Lin has arranged the dishes on a table in the venue's kitchen. The client had told Lin they preferred mild flavors, but after tasting the spicy dish, they pause and say they actually love the heat. They then reveal they have already signed with another caterer but want to change their decision. Lin checks the calendar, finding the wedding date is still open.
text_zh: 餐饮承办人林某在预定的品鉴会上为客户准备了一份样品菜单。客户正在决定是否聘请林某承办一场大型婚礼。林某将菜肴摆放在场地厨房的桌子上。客户曾告诉林某他们偏好清淡口味，但尝过辣菜后，他们停顿了一下，说其实很喜欢这种辣味。随后他们透露已经和另一家承办商签约，但想改变决定。林某查看日历，发现婚礼日期仍然空着。

text_en: A caterer, Lin, has prepared a sample menu for a client at a scheduled tasting. The client is deciding whether to book Lin for a large wedding. Lin has arranged the dishes on a table in the venue's kitchen. Midway through the tasting, the client's phone rings. They answer and their face turns pale. A family member has been rushed to the hospital. The client apologizes and leaves immediately, leaving the dishes half-eaten. Lin worries that the booking will fall through, but more urgently, she wonders if the client will be okay.
text_zh: 餐饮承办人林某在预定的品鉴会上为客户准备了一份样品菜单。客户正在决定是否聘请林某承办一场大型婚礼。林某将菜肴摆放在场地厨房的桌子上。品鉴进行到一半，客户的电话响了。他们接起电话，脸色变得苍白。一位家人被紧急送往医院。客户道歉后立即离开，菜肴只吃了一半。林某担心预订会落空，但更紧迫的是，她想知道客户是否安好。

text_en: A caterer, Lin, has prepared a sample menu for a client at a scheduled tasting. The client is deciding whether to book Lin for a large wedding. Lin has arranged the dishes on a table in the venue's kitchen. As Lin lifts the lid off the main course, she notices a small cockroach crawling out from under the rim of the serving platter. It scurries across the table and disappears behind a stack of napkins. The client has not seen it yet, but Lin knows she must remove the entire dish and sanitize the area before continuing.
text_zh: 餐饮承办人林某在预定的品鉴会上为客户准备了一份样品菜单。客户正在决定是否聘请林某承办一场大型婚礼。林某将菜肴摆放在场地厨房的桌子上。林某揭开主菜锅盖时，发现一只小蟑螂从餐盘边缘下方爬出来。它迅速爬过桌子，消失在餐巾堆后面。客户还没看到，但林某知道她必须撤掉整道菜并消毒该区域，然后才能继续。

text_en: A caterer, Lin, has prepared a sample menu for a client at a scheduled tasting. The client is deciding whether to book Lin for a large wedding. Lin has arranged the dishes on a table in the venue's kitchen. The client's phone buzzes with a message from their wedding planner. The planner has just informed them that Lin's competitor has been spreading false rumors about Lin's hygiene standards. The client reads the message aloud, then looks at Lin with suspicion. Lin realizes a rival deliberately sabotaged her reputation to steal this booking.
text_zh: 餐饮承办人林某在预定的品鉴会上为客户准备了一份样品菜单。客户正在决定是否聘请林某承办一场大型婚礼。林某将菜肴摆放在场地厨房的桌子上。客户的手机收到婚礼策划人的消息。策划人刚告知他们，林某的竞争对手在散布关于林某卫生标准的虚假谣言。客户大声读出消息，然后怀疑地看着林某。林某意识到是竞争对手故意破坏她的声誉，想抢走这笔订单。

text_en: A caterer, Lin, has prepared a sample menu for a client at a scheduled tasting. The client is deciding whether to book Lin for a large wedding. Lin has arranged the dishes on a table in the venue's kitchen. The client finishes tasting and thanks Lin politely, but explains that their wedding has been cancelled due to a family emergency. They will not need catering services after all. Lin watches them leave, knowing the months of menu planning and the carefully sourced ingredients will now go to waste. She begins clearing the untouched dishes.
text_zh: 餐饮承办人林某在预定的品鉴会上为客户准备了一份样品菜单。客户正在决定是否聘请林某承办一场大型婚礼。林某将菜肴摆放在场地厨房的桌子上。客户尝完所有菜肴，礼貌地感谢林某，但解释说由于家庭紧急情况，婚礼已取消，他们不再需要餐饮服务。林某看着他们离开，知道数月的菜单规划和精心采购的食材现在都将浪费。她开始收拾未动过的菜肴。

text_en: A caterer, Lin, has prepared a sample menu for a client at a scheduled tasting. The client is deciding whether to book Lin for a large wedding. Lin has arranged the dishes on a table in the venue's kitchen. The client finishes tasting each dish, makes a few notes on their phone, and asks a standard question about pricing for additional servings. Lin answers with the usual rate. The client says they will review the options and get back to her next week. Lin thanks them and begins clearing the table, expecting a routine follow-up.
text_zh: 餐饮承办人林某在预定的品鉴会上为客户准备了一份样品菜单。客户正在决定是否聘请林某承办一场大型婚礼。林某将菜肴摆放在场地厨房的桌子上。客户尝完每道菜，在手机上做了些笔记，并询问了关于额外份量定价的常规问题。林某按通常费率回答。客户说他们会考虑选项，下周再回复她。林某道谢后开始收拾桌子，期待一次常规的后续跟进。

text_en: After finishing a timed oral exercise in a language class, an adult learner named Lin walks to the instructor's desk. The instructor holds a scoring sheet with notes. Lin waits quietly while the instructor reviews the results. The room is calm, and other students are still working. The instructor looks up and says that Lin's pronunciation and fluency met the highest standard on the rubric. The instructor adds that Lin's progress over the past month has been remarkable, and that this score qualifies Lin for the advanced conversation group. Lin immediately thinks about signing up for the next session and telling a close friend about the good news.
text_zh: 在语言课上完成一项限时口语练习后，一位名叫林的成年学员走向讲台。老师手里拿着一张带有评语的评分表。林安静地等着老师查看结果。教室里很安静，其他学生仍在练习。老师抬起头，说林的发音和流利度达到了评分表上的最高标准。老师补充说，林过去一个月的进步非常显著，这个分数让林有资格进入高级会话组。林立刻想到报名下一期课程，并把这个好消息告诉一位好友。

text_en: After finishing a timed oral exercise in a language class, an adult learner named Lin walks to the instructor's desk. The instructor holds a scoring sheet with notes. Lin waits quietly while the instructor reviews the results. The room is calm, and other students are still working. The instructor says that Lin's score is exactly the same as the score from the previous attempt, down to the same decimal point. Lin had expected a different result because the exercise felt harder this time. Lin checks the sheet twice to confirm the identical numbers, then considers asking the instructor whether the scoring system might have a glitch.
text_zh: 在语言课上完成一项限时口语练习后，一位名叫林的成年学员走向讲台。老师手里拿着一张带有评语的评分表。林安静地等着老师查看结果。教室里很安静，其他学生仍在练习。老师说林的分数和上次尝试的分数完全相同，连小数点后都一样。林本以为这次结果会不同，因为这次练习感觉更难。林反复看了两遍评分表确认数字一致，然后考虑问老师评分系统是否可能有故障。

text_en: After finishing a timed oral exercise in a language class, an adult learner named Lin walks to the instructor's desk. The instructor holds a scoring sheet with notes. Lin waits quietly while the instructor reviews the results. The room is calm, and other students are still working. The instructor points to a note indicating that Lin's response included a phrase that could be interpreted as a security threat in the context of the course's workplace scenario. The instructor says this will be reported to the program coordinator, and Lin's enrollment may be reviewed. Lin thinks about contacting the coordinator immediately to explain the misunderstanding before any action is taken.
text_zh: 在语言课上完成一项限时口语练习后，一位名叫林的成年学员走向讲台。老师手里拿着一张带有评语的评分表。林安静地等着老师查看结果。教室里很安静，其他学生仍在练习。老师指着一条备注，说林的回答中包含一个短语，在课程的工作场景语境下可能被解读为安全威胁。老师说这将被上报给项目协调员，林的注册资格可能会被审查。林想着立即联系协调员解释这个误会，以免采取任何措施。

text_en: After finishing a timed oral exercise in a language class, an adult learner named Lin walks to the instructor's desk. The instructor holds a scoring sheet with notes. Lin waits quietly while the instructor reviews the results. The room is calm, and other students are still working. The instructor slides the scoring sheet toward Lin and points to a sticky note on the corner. The note has a dark, greasy stain and a faint sour smell, as if it had been left near spoiled food. Lin sees that the instructor's comment is written partly over the stain. Lin decides to ask for a clean copy of the feedback rather than touch the sheet again.
text_zh: 在语言课上完成一项限时口语练习后，一位名叫林的成年学员走向讲台。老师手里拿着一张带有评语的评分表。林安静地等着老师查看结果。教室里很安静，其他学生仍在练习。老师把评分表滑向林，并指着角落的一张便利贴。便利贴上有深色油渍和淡淡的酸味，像是放在变质食物旁边留下的。林看到老师的评语有一部分写在污渍上。林决定要求一份干净的反馈副本，而不是再碰那张纸。

text_en: After finishing a timed oral exercise in a language class, an adult learner named Lin walks to the instructor's desk. The instructor holds a scoring sheet with notes. Lin waits quietly while the instructor reviews the results. The room is calm, and other students are still working. The instructor says that Lin's score was lowered because Lin did not greet the instructor by name at the start of the exercise, even though the instructions never mentioned that requirement. The instructor adds that this rule was applied only to Lin, not to other students. Lin considers pointing out the inconsistency and asking for a re-evaluation based on the original criteria.
text_zh: 在语言课上完成一项限时口语练习后，一位名叫林的成年学员走向讲台。老师手里拿着一张带有评语的评分表。林安静地等着老师查看结果。教室里很安静，其他学生仍在练习。老师说林的分数被扣了，因为林在练习开始时没有称呼老师的名字，尽管说明中从未提到这一要求。老师补充说，这条规则只对林适用，对其他学生不适用。林考虑指出这种不一致，并请求根据原始标准重新评分。

text_en: After finishing a timed oral exercise in a language class, an adult learner named Lin walks to the instructor's desk. The instructor holds a scoring sheet with notes. Lin waits quietly while the instructor reviews the results. The room is calm, and other students are still working. The instructor explains that Lin's score is below the passing threshold, and because this is the final attempt, Lin will not be able to continue in the course. The instructor also mentions that the next available class starts in six months. Lin looks at the sheet, then slowly gathers belongings, thinking about how much effort had gone into preparing for this exercise.
text_zh: 在语言课上完成一项限时口语练习后，一位名叫林的成年学员走向讲台。老师手里拿着一张带有评语的评分表。林安静地等着老师查看结果。教室里很安静，其他学生仍在练习。老师解释说林的分数低于及格线，而这是最后一次尝试，林将无法继续这门课程。老师还提到下一期课程要六个月后才开始。林看着评分表，然后慢慢收拾东西，想着为这次练习付出了多少努力。

text_en: After finishing a timed oral exercise in a language class, an adult learner named Lin walks to the instructor's desk. The instructor holds a scoring sheet with notes. Lin waits quietly while the instructor reviews the results. The room is calm, and other students are still working.
